input.prompt: Image 1 is a simple cross section drawing of a small cellar under a kitchen. Images 2 and 3 are photos of this same cellar: image 2 looks down the staircase from the kitchen, image 3 shows the room, its shelves and the foot of the staircase. Make a real photograph from inside the cellar, standing on the stone floor near the shelves, looking back up the same straight wooden staircase with its handrail to the open trapdoor at the top, where soft daylight from the kitchen falls down the steps; the edge of a shelf with jars in the foreground and the one warm lamp. Same staircase, same walls, same floor, same shelves and same light as images 2 and 3. The cellar has only: a door sized wooden trapdoor in the kitchen floor, lifted open; one straight wooden staircase of about twelve steps with a wooden handrail along one wall; a room of standing height, about 2.2 meters, with a level stone floor and plain lime plaster walls; one warm light; sturdy wooden shelves on two walls holding glass jars of fruit and vegetables, sacks of rice and beans, and big glass water jugs. One straight staircase, no other stairs, no labels, no other rooms, no people. No other buildings, no barns, no sheds. Real photograph, Kodak Portra 400 look, natural true colors, soft fine grain, real camera optics. No text, no letters, no signs, no labels, no logos, no watermark anywhere.
